description: Load Combination Contribution Analyzer, step 1. Without name: lists the model's General-tab load combinations (LCOM-GEN) with type (ADD, ENVELOPE, ABS, SRSS), constituent count, whether it is a max/min pair, and whether it can be decomposed (refused: time-history, unknown analysis type, undefined constituents, self-reference, a constituent whose type differs from the case of that name) — plus the result tables the model has items for (BEAM, TRUSS, PLATE, ELASTICLINK, GENLINK, REACTION, DISPLACEMENT) with their components and units, structure groups, construction stages and the model's units. With name: that combination's full tree (nested combinations, factors, kinds), the effective factor of every load case over all Add paths (a case reached down several branches gets the sum of the path products), and the envelopes / ABS / SRSS inside it. Read-only.

name.description: A combination to show in full. Omit to list them all.

search.description: Only combinations whose name contains this (case-insensitive).

units.description: Units to report in (CIVIL NX converts). Default: the model's own.

name: combination_tree
title: Combinations: list them, or show one's tree
